architecture: tau_j = trig(q1..q6) @ learned_coeff_j + learnedKp_j*(own_reference_j-counted_q_j) + learnedKd_j*(own_desired_speed_j-counted_qd_j); clip output to +/-30Nm
training_reference: expert internal q_des and qd_des only during coefficient identification
runtime_reference: student generated, never simulator or expert
fit_rule: linear fit to unsaturated abs(torque)<29.5Nm rows, equal mean per eligible run; validation scores ALL rows after actual output clipping
